cards.name: The Jasmine Blossom
cards.deduction: Grace, quiet beauty, and pure elegance. A sweet scent blooming under the stars, gentle yet completely unforgettable.

cards.name: Nanami's Ratio
cards.deduction: Calm, razor-sharp, and effortlessly stylish. Overtime might be a pain, but having this much natural swagger is second nature.

cards.name: The Crimson Apple
cards.deduction: A taste for the crisp, bold, and classic. You don't settle for ordinary—you want the brightest fruit on the tree.

cards.name: The Feline Spirit
cards.deduction: Independent, razor-sharp instincts, and deeply affectionate to those who earn your trust. A true cat soul.
